the generalized Morse wavelets, especially Airy wavelets, provide the most flexible and versatile wavelet family that has been discovered to date.

, by judicious choice of the shape parameter γ, the generalized Morse wavelet superfamily provides a flexible and systematic means for exploring the trade-off between time-frequency concentration, symmetry and analyticity.
